name: Diocletian’s Palace
description: Roman palace walls still form Split’s old-town streets and courtyards.

name: Dubrovnik City Walls
description: Stone ramparts circle Dubrovnik’s Old Town above the Adriatic.

name: Euphrasian Basilica
description: Byzantine mosaics decorate this Istrian UNESCO church complex.

name: Pula Arena
description: A well-preserved Roman amphitheatre still hosts events by the Istrian coast.

name: Zagreb Cathedral
description: Twin Neo-Gothic spires mark Zagreb’s cathedral on Kaptol.

name: Plitvice Lakes
description: Turquoise lakes linked by waterfalls and boardwalks in a national park.

name: Hvar town
description: A harbour town with a hilltop fortress and island beaches.

name: Krka National Park
description: Waterfalls and boardwalks along the Krka river inland from Šibenik.

name: Rovinj old town
description: Pastel houses climb to a hilltop church on Istria’s west coast.

name: Mljet National Park
description: Forest and saltwater lakes cover much of this southern Adriatic island.

name: Dolac Market
description: Zagreb’s main open market sells produce above the old town steps.

name: Pazar market Split
description: Outdoor stalls beside Diocletian’s Palace sell fruit, vegetables and snacks.

name: Gundulićeva poljana market
description: A small morning market in Dubrovnik’s Old Town sells local produce.

name: Rijeka market
description: Covered and open stalls by the harbour sell Adriatic fish and produce.

name: Tkalčićeva Street cafés
description: A café street in Zagreb’s Upper Town area for coffee and light meals.

name: Dubrovnik Summer Festival
description: Open-air theatre, music and dance performances fill Old Town venues each summer.
